24.intro: Laur. Plut. 32.24 ends with fol. 233v, which breaks off at line 103 of this book; the codex has no further leaves, so lines 104-548 are not in this manuscript and are not given here.
24.english_note: Murray's last five-line block here (24.100-104) includes his translation of 24.104 (ξεῖνος γάρ οἱ ἔην Ἰθάκῃ ἔνι οἰκία ναίων), which is not on this page: the manuscript ends with 24.103.
